perks.proCredits: 3x the monthly AI credits of Plus
perks.businessEverything: Everything in Pro, for everyone on the team
perks.businessSso: SAML single sign-on, included and not an add-on
perks.businessSeats: Per seat, bought by your company

signInBody: Sign in to unlock {intro}, and every feature, completely free. The SQL editor works without an account.
ssoLookup: We will look for the single sign-on set up for {domain}.
ssoDomainOnly: Only the domain of this address is sent, to find your company's identity provider.
waiting: Waiting for the browser sign-in to finish…
browserNote: A browser window opens to complete sign-in, then returns to the app.
onTeamPlan: On your team's plan, not a personal subscription.
usageSoon: Your AI usage will appear here once you have asked {assistant} something.
nearLimit: You're near your monthly limit. Once it runs out, AI usage pauses until it resets.
upgradePaid: Upgrade for a bigger balance, or buy extra credits that never expire.
upgradeFree: Upgrade anytime for a bigger balance.
useCreditsToggle: Use credits after my monthly limit
creditsOn: When your monthly balance runs out, the assistant keeps going on your credits until they're gone.
creditsOff: Off: when your monthly balance runs out, AI pauses and your credits are saved until next month.
creditsNote: Credits never expire and are spent only after your monthly balance, and only when the toggle above is on. Purchased securely at
drawsCredits: each request draws from your monthly AI credits
everyRequest: Every request draws from your monthly AI credits. When they run out, AI usage pauses until your balance resets.
balanceFromSeat: Your balance comes with your team seat.
seatNote: Your seat is part of your team's plan, so the plan and the billing are your team admin's to change, not yours. Single sign-on is included.
proPitch: Pro gives you 3x the monthly AI credits of Plus, for heavier days, plus first access to new models. Change your plan anytime at
pricingNote: Prices, and the models each plan includes, are on
